implementedThisSession.name: Combo AOE touch
details: Manual combo count 10-20 gives a 25% chance per manual touch to AOE touch the 8 surrounding tiles.
Manual combo count above 20 gives a 50% chance.
AOE touches use existing touch/drop/audio feedback but do not increment combo and do not recursively trigger AOE.

implementedThisSession.name: Perfect Touch timing mechanic
details: Freshly regrown tiles are marked for a short Perfect Touch window.
Manual touches during the window grant bonus Grass Touches.
Fresh tiles show a gold-green ring/sparkle cue.
Perfect Touch has a dedicated crisp procedural sound.

implementedThisSession.name: Earthworm companion
details: Earthworm added as a Gold Store animal.
Periodically shortens remaining regrowth time on resting patches.
Has generated world sprite, field ambience, burrow action feedback, and journal note.

implementedThisSession.name: Weather visuals and synergies
details: Weather particles made more distinct: rain streaks, breeze leaves, seed wind, pollen motes, sun motes, root motes.
Weather tints strengthened.
Soft Rain and Dewy Morning extend Perfect Touch windows.
Restless Roots shortens Perfect Touch window.
Lucky Breeze boosts combo AOE chance.
Golden Hour can add gold on Perfect Touch.
Warm Sunlight and Soft Rain improve Earthworm regrowth help.
